name: gogs
description: Agent skills for installing and configuring Gogs, maintaining it with the admin CLI and backups, and automating it through the REST API.

interface.longDescription: Skills for Gogs, the painless self-hosted Git service. Covers installation (database setup, binary or Docker, a minimal app.ini with environment-expanded secrets, first admin); server maintenance with gogs admin subcommands and gogs backup/restore for migrations and database switches; and automation through the /api/v1 REST API with access tokens, covering repositories, migrations and mirrors, contents, issues, webhooks, admin endpoints and Link-header pagination.
defaultPrompt: Set up Gogs with PostgreSQL behind my domain
Back up this Gogs server and restore it on a new machine
Mirror these GitHub repos into Gogs with the API
